lens: conviction (PROTOCOL_V3 Addendum I): a stake per trade from what is known at the decision
written: 2026-11-12, after the first check (repro.json: the ten sleeves reproduced row by row) and BEFORE part 1 and before any stake variant was evaluated. Only counts of trades and of finite descriptor values were looked at before writing this file.
data: in sample only. Signals and baseline chains: the context lens's tables (results/r2/autopsy/context/signals, chains), built from price frames read with ts < 2022-01-01; chains re-simulated here on the same in-sample frames (rows ts < 2022-01-01) when a stake of 0 removes a signal; official trades read with entry_time < 2022-01-01 only for the first check.
account: PLAIN SUM of the ten sleeves' one-position chains (no position caps, no compounding), 1 R per trade times the variant's stake multiplier. Kept the same throughout. (The capped account of the cluster lens is not used.)
weeks: FP server weeks (New York + 7 h, Monday..Sunday); stake x R booked in the week of the trade's EXIT time; every calendar week counted (empty weeks = 0). Out-of-fold window: the 157 server weeks whose Thursday falls in 2019, 2020 or 2021 (Mondays 2018-12-31 .. 2021-12-27); a week belongs to the year of its Thursday.

measure.weekly_sharpe: mean / standard deviation (ddof 1) of the weekly sums x sqrt(52)
measure.equal_swing: the variant's stakes are all multiplied by k = sd(reference weekly R) / sd(variant weekly R) over the 157 out-of-fold weeks (same k for every year and measure), separately in each cost mode
measure.reported: weekly Sharpe (pooled 2019-2021 and per year), total R, share of losing weeks (weeks with R < 0 among all weeks), worst week, longest run of losing weeks, losing trades per month (trades with stake > 0 and R < 0, exit in the window, per month), number of trades, mean stake, share of trades at each stake, k; FP costs and costs x1.5

definitions.signal: one row of the context lens's signal table (one per order of the rule): decision time t_dec, side, risk (the rule's stop distance known at t_dec), P (mid close of the last bar that started before t_dec) and the causal descriptors
definitions.baseline_chain: the sleeve's own one-position chain at unit stakes (context lens chain file; = official trades minus the trade still open at the end of the slice)
definitions.training_set_for_year_Y: the baseline chain trades of the same sleeve and cost mode whose exit_time <= Y-01-01 00:00 UTC minus 7 days (outcome known); expanding window from the first trade of the sleeve; outcome = the trade's R in that cost mode
definitions.stakes_apply_to: signals whose fold year is 2019, 2020 or 2021; every other signal has stake 1
definitions.zero_stake: a stake of 0 removes the signal's order and the sleeve's chain is re-simulated (one position at a time, same simulator, same in-sample frame, same costs): a skipped signal frees the sleeve for a later one; a stake > 0 multiplies the trade's R and never changes which trades are taken
definitions.split_q: on the finite training values of a descriptor (or score): b_lo = quantile(q), b_hi = quantile(1 - q) (numpy linear interpolation); x is 'lo' if x <= b_lo, 'hi' if x >= b_hi, else 'mid'; NaN -> stake 1; if b_lo >= b_hi the descriptor is not eligible that year
definitions.separation: Welch t of training R between the 'hi' and 'lo' groups, (mean_hi - mean_lo) / sqrt(var_hi / n_hi + var_lo / n_lo), ddof 1; eligible only with >= 60 finite training values and >= 10 trades in each of 'lo' and 'hi'
definitions.mapping_M: the extreme group ('lo' or 'hi') with the lower training mean is 'worst', the other extreme 'best'; stake worst = 0.5, or 0 when the worst group's training mean <= +0.02 R; mid = 1; best = 1.5. The 'nozero' mapping always gives worst = 0.5.
definitions.eligible_descriptors: vol, al1, al5, al20, room, cushion, trig, riskbp, rel, rel2, prev, oth24 (context lens definitions; riskbp = 10,000 x risk / P replaces sprR because the FP frames' spread is scaled by the day's median spread, which is not causal; hour and weekday are left to the clock lens). Part 1 also reports hour of the decision (hour_dec), weekday and sprR, for information only.
definitions.agreement: n_same / n_opp = number of OTHER sleeves of the same market (us100: ocm4, noise30; xauusd: donch4h_stop, orb_asia_2d_buf10, GOLD_FRI_PM; btcusd: brk72_24h_wd, F1_brk_ridge_filter, nq_btc_follow; ethusd: brk72_24h_wd, F1_brk_ridge_filter) whose REALISED chain holds a position at t_dec on the same / opposite side: entry_time < t_dec < exit_time (lab convention: entry_time = fill bar start; exit_time = exit bar start for time exits, start + 1 minute otherwise). 'agree' = n_same > 0 and n_opp = 0; 'disagree' = n_opp > 0 and n_same = 0; else 'neither'. Realised chain = the chain actually traded under the variant (after any zero-stake removals); agreement never gives a stake of 0, so it never changes a chain.

part1: description, no selection: per sleeve, cost mode and descriptor (eligible list + hour_dec, dow, sprR), terciles (q = 1/3, split_q) fitted on the training set of year Y, then year Y's baseline chain trades (fold year Y): n and mean R per tercile, for Y = 2019, 2020, 2021 and pooled; agreement / neither / disagreement groups the same way (no fit). Reported apart and judging nothing: 2016-2018 for the gold and us100 sleeves, 2018 for btcusd (training >= 60).

variants.rule: every stake 1
per sleeve and fold year: among the eligible descriptors, the one with the largest |separation| (q = 1/3) on the training set; stakes by mapping_M with q = 1/3; no eligible descriptor -> stake 1

the four crypto breakouts (brk72_24h_wd btcusd / ethusd, F1_brk_ridge_filter btcusd / ethusd) pooled: per fold year, each eligible descriptor except rel2 is standardised per sleeve with that sleeve's training mean and sd (clipped to +/-4, NaN -> 0); y = training R clipped to [-2, 4]; y and z are demeaned within sleeve (= sleeve dummies); screening: the 6 descriptors with the largest |Pearson correlation| between z and y on the pooled training set; ridge on those 6, penalty alpha = 1.0 x n_train; score = beta . z; pooled training split of the score (q = 1/3); stakes: 'lo' = 0.5 (0 when that sleeve's training mean in its 'lo' group <= +0.02 R), 'mid' = 1, 'hi' = 1.5; the six other sleeves stake 1
variants.params_per_sleeve: about 2.25 ((6 shared coefficients + 2 shared boundaries) / 4 sleeves + the shared screening choice)

counted: V01-V28 = 28 of the budget of 30 (26 stake variants and the two controls V21, V22; the reference V00 is not counted); 2 left unused. Every one is logged in trials.jsonl, FP and costs x1.5 (the controls in FP only).

candidate_criteria.a: pooled 2019-2021 FP weekly Sharpe of the variant >= 1.10 x the reference's
candidate_criteria.b: FP weekly Sharpe above the reference's in at least 2 of 2019, 2020, 2021
candidate_criteria.c: (a) and (b) also hold with costs x1.5 (every fit, removal and chain redone on the x1.5 tables, against the x1.5 reference)
candidate_criteria.d: every declared neighbour has a pooled 2019-2021 FP weekly Sharpe above the reference's (variants without declared neighbours cannot be candidates)
candidate_criteria.e: truncation test: for 30 random out-of-fold chain decisions per sleeve (seed 7) plus up to 30 signals the variant sets to 0, every descriptor recomputed on price frames cut at t_dec (bars that start before t_dec; related markets too), prev / oth24 and the agreement recomputed from trade lists masked at t_dec (only entries before t_dec; an exit only if exit_time <= t_dec), the year's fit recomputed from a training table physically truncated at the training cut; the stake must be identical every time
candidate_criteria.f: stakes between 0 and 2 times the base before the equal-swing scaling, and at most 3 fitted parameters per sleeve (count stated per variant; V10 breaches it by construction)
candidate_criteria.ranking_if_several: highest pooled 2019-2021 FP weekly Sharpe ratio to the reference; every candidate is then attacked by an independent re-implementation (not part of this lens)

said_with_any_result: found on the years that built the rules (the ten rules were selected on 2013-2021 and the F1 scorecard was fitted on candidates up to 2021-12-27), so optimistic even out of fold; the measure that counts is the validation look, then the demo account; stakes below the broker's minimum lot are skipped on a small account (Addendum E).
